title: Efficacy of Vaccination Under Novel Immunomodulatory Therapies in Patients with Myasthenia Gravis : A Prospective Analysis (VaxIT-Study)
summary:
The aim of the VaxIT study is to analyse the immune response to a SARS-CoV-2 vaccination in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) under therapy with novel immunomodulatory drugs. The efficacy of the vaccinations in these patients has not yet been sufficiently researched, particularly with regard to the possible interactions between the immunosuppressants and the vaccination response.
To this end, the vaccination response will be compared by taking blood samples before and after vaccination. This will allow conclusions to be drawn about the extent to which these novel immunomodulatory therapies have an influence on the vaccination response to a SARS-CoV2 vaccination.

interventions.name: Evaluation of the vaccination response in patients with myasthenia gravis receiving novel immunomodulatory therapies.
